But the two multiplications reach no priced reading: the GAE charges group operations only (oracle_setup gae = adds + doubles exactly); tw_aut_canonicalisations sits in the relations phase native map and is NOT in cost.unpriced, so the 5a band does not charge it; bitop/v1 lists it in work.unpriced and charges no field_mul for it (tw2cj-lazy-aut3 oracle_setup prims are group_add, group_double, hash_probe only); for non-sib walks walk_ops.field_ops is not even emitted (tw_walk_muls only exists with sib). tw_aut_canonicalisations equals table_insert_attempts on every aut3 record. The code comment 'Counted, not priced in GAE ... (as rho.cubic)' and the commit message 'charges two field multiplications, as rho.cubic charges its rotations' hold for the internal field_ops tally only. Nothing else is hidden: 0 lazy failures, 0 dropped rows on 1,260 aut3 runs; rotated collisions are 0.66-0.69 of collisions on tw2cj-lazy-aut3 (theory 2/3).

CubicClasses::canon does the same two multiplications by omega (ops.field_ops.muls += 2) and its canonicalisations are emitted as canonicalisations_uncharged and listed in cost.unpriced: the band charges rho-cubic w per canonicalisation (mean 68,072 / 177,602 / 440,418 per run at p34/37/40). bitop/v1 charges them too (natives field_mul = 2 x canonicalisations on 630/630 measured-or-warm-up rho-cubic records; modr_mul = 3 x, plus 1 on 15). rho-cubic GAE = group operations only (total_gae = bitop group_add + group_double on 630/630; every IC phase has gae = adds + doubles exactly). errata.severity: changes reported numbers, not the verdict
errata.location: README.md results table and 'What this means' (1.05-1.11 at w = 0.1, 1.8-1.9 at w = 1); results.json and band-*.json w = 0.1 / w = 1 values; bench record metric sib8_p512_aut3_over_rho_cubic_gae_w1_p40 = 1.912; commit message of 011e143f00; engine b460422af6 (tw_aut_canonicalisations not in cost.unpriced)
errata.issue: The 5a band charges rho-cubic w per canonicalisation (canonicalisations_uncharged, in cost.unpriced) but does not charge the aut=3 IC arms for the same operation (two multiplications by omega per stored or probed point, counted as tw_aut_canonicalisations, kept out of cost.unpriced and out of every counted: marker). AGENTS.md 5a requires the band to be applied the same way to every arm, and the 2026-11-08 table-work rule closed the same kind of asymmetry. Pricing one native operation per aut=3 canonicalisation, as rho-cubic's are priced, gives sib8-p512-aut3 / rho-cubic = 0.886 / 1.210 / 2.677 (p34), 0.901 / 1.235 / 2.742 (p37), 0.929 / 1.276 / 2.838 (p40) at w = 0 / 0.1 / 1, against the reported 0.886 / 1.052 / 1.806, 0.901 / 1.073 / 1.848, 0.929 / 1.108 / 1.912. w = 0 is unchanged; the order is still unresolved in the band at every size; per curve still 13 unresolved and 2 rho-cubic lower.
errata.fix: Restate the band values as lower bounds for the IC arm, or rerun the band after listing tw_aut_canonicalisations as unpriced (an engine change and a new record format, so a new frozen stage); correct the w1_p40 bench metric; do not cite 1.05-1.11 / 1.8-1.9 as the band.
